column2: -2.1970377177095908 The Disappearing Church of Priors Norton https://seventowers.org.uk/ringoutthebells/ St Mary's Church in Priors Norton is locally renowned as the "disappearing church" because its unique topographical positioning creates an optical illusion that causes the building to vanish from sight as travelers pass along the A38. Built just beyond the brow of a hill
column3: this historic landmark has long amazed passersby who watch the structure seemingly sink into the earth. #weird#church
